Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-af 48V 0.32A (15W) PoE Adapter

The Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-af 48V 0.32A (15W) PoE Adapter is a powerful and efficient solution designed to simplify network deployment by delivering both data and power over a single Ethernet cable. With a maximum output of 48V DC at 0.32A, this adapter provides 15W of power, making it suitable for a range of devices, including access points, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. This adapter features robust surge protection, including both difference and common mode protection, ensuring that connected devices remain safe from electrical spikes. Clamping protection is set at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, enhancing the overall safety of your network. With a maximum surge discharge capacity of 1500A, it is built to withstand challenging electrical environments. Efficiency is a key highlight, as the U-POE-af achieves an impressive efficiency rating of 84.25%, minimizing energy loss and contributing to lower operating costs. Its switching frequency of 65 kHz and a manageable output ripple of 200mV p-p guarantee stable power delivery, while line regulation at ≤ 3% and load regulation at ≤ 5% ensure consistent performance under varying conditions. The adapter operates effectively within a temperature range of 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and a humidity range of 5% to 90% non-condensing, making it versatile for various installation environments. It features a compact design with dimensions of 86 x 46 x 33 mm (3.39 x 1.81 x 1.30 inches) and weighs only 100 g (3.53 oz), allowing for easy integration into any setup. Equipped with a gigabit LAN port and compliant with multiple safety certifications (CE, FCC, IC, UL), the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-af is a reliable choice for enhancing your network infrastructure with efficient power delivery and superior protection.

Features of the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-af 48V 0.32A PoE Adapter

  • Power Output: Provides 48V DC at 0.32A, delivering a total power output of 15W, suitable for various network devices.
  • Surge Protection: Includes difference and common mode surge protection, safeguarding connected devices from voltage spikes.
  • Clamping Protection: Features clamping at 11V for data lines and 60V for power, ensuring additional safety for sensitive ele
  • High Efficiency: Achieves an efficiency rating of 84.25%, reducing energy loss and promoting cost-effective operation.
  • Compact Design: Small dimensions of 86 x 46 x 33 mm (3.39 x 1.81 x 1.30 inches) and a lightweight of 100 g (3.53 oz) for easy installation in various environments.
  • Wide Operating Range: Operates efficiently within a temperature range of 0 to 40°C (32 to 104°F) and humidity levels of 5% to 90% non-condensing.
  • Regulation Performance: Maintains line regulation of ≤ 3% and load regulation of ≤ 5%, ensuring stable power delivery under varying loads.
  • Fast Response Time: Features a response time of less than 1 nanosecond, allowing for quick adjustments to power demands.
  • Connectivity Options: Equipped with a gigabit LAN port for high-speed data transmission alongside power delivery.
  • Robust Protection: Capable of handling a maximum surge discharge of 1500A, providing strong protection against electrical surges.
  • Multiple Certifications: Complies with CE, FCC, IC, and UL certifications, ensuring reliable and safe operation.

These features make the Ubiquiti UniFi U-POE-af an excellent choice for powering and managing network devices effectively.
